I plan on being in this house a long time. Are the more expensive units worth it over the long haul?

If you depend on the AC function a lot, then absolutely. What you need to do is look at the SEER rating. It's short for Seasonal Energy Efficiency Rating. The higher the SEER, the more energy efficient the machine. It mostly has to do with the compressor for the AC part of the system.

It has a huge impact on energy consumption. Go for the highest SEER with a system that is load matched to your house when you make the replacement.

The energy savings over the life of the machine will justify the increased expense, especially if you live in a place that is very warm during the summer season.
